description: Application created but not yet submitted
notes: Most portals retain drafts for a limited period

description: Application submitted and acknowledgement number issued
notes: Acknowledgement number is the tracking key

description: Application under verification by the implementing authority
citizen_action_required: No - unless a query is raised
notes: Multi-level verification is common (institution, district, state)

description: Verifying authority has sought clarification or a corrected document
citizen_action_required: Yes - respond within the stated period
notes: A frequent cause of rejection when the applicant does not respond in time
For credit-linked schemes, sanction precedes disbursement

description: Application rejected on eligibility or documentation grounds
notes: Rejection reasons should be recorded; appeal routes differ by scheme

description: Benefit credited, delivered or service rendered
notes: For instalment schemes this status recurs per instalment

description: Benefit cycle complete or loan fully repaid
notes: For recurring schemes, closure applies to a cycle rather than the enrolment
